Green Industries applications must respond to moisture, ultraviolet exposure, soil, living systems, maintenance, and end-of-life. A beautiful prototype that sheds unsuitable material outdoors or cannot be cleaned is not a successful green solution.

## Project directions

:::: {.ter-project-grid}
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Durable plant-information system
<p class="ter-course-code">THJ2O · Display family</p>
Design a consistent label and support for plants in one real indoor or outdoor setting.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Site audit → content hierarchy → material test → prototype → weather/cleaning review</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Species research, typography, stakes, lifecycle comparison</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Introductory–intermediate · three-label family</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Reused or responsibly chosen weather-suitable stock</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Resist rotation and soil forces without harming roots</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Round exposed edges; verify material suitability around plants and soil</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=green-industries&type=themed-starters">Nature design starters</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../02-digital-design/04-layout-typography-colour.qmd">Layout, Type & Colour</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Add an accessible web record without making the label depend on a QR code</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Propagation tracking organizer
<p class="ter-course-code">THJ2O · Organizer family</p>
Create a washable, modular system that keeps batches and records aligned during plant propagation.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Workflow map → tray measurement → divider mock-up → cleaning test</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Batch coding, modular layout, moisture-aware materials, evaluation</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · fits one existing tray</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Washable approved sheet or reusable tag stock</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Dividers must not trap water or damage containers</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Use plant-safe materials and follow local sanitation procedures</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=green-industries&type=project-components">Tags and dividers</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../01-nice-design-process/02-investigate-inquire.qmd">Investigate & Inquire</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Track error rate and material condition over one growth cycle</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Portable field-observation module
<p class="ter-course-code">Related senior courses · Portable work module</p>
Organize non-powered observation and sampling tools for a defined school-ground study.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Field-task analysis → inventory → layout → carry test → wet/dirty workflow review</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Tool control, data sheets, handles, repairability, environmental constraints</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · one-person carry</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Sealed plywood, reused container, replaceable dividers</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Test handle and closure with the actual permitted load</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>No chemical, sharp, or biological sampling without an approved protocol</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=green-industries&type=french-cleat">Modular organization geometry</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../03-laser-cutting/07-wall-bench-module.qmd">Wall + Bench Module</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Design a repair plan and material recovery route</dd></dl>
:::
